h1: Do I need a permit for solar panels in Newton, MA?
title: Solar Panel Permits in Newton, MA
description: Newton's fee schedule lists building permits for solar panels, with and without structural work, plus a separate electrical permit for solar.
short_answer: Yes. Newton's permit fee schedule lists a building permit category for solar panels without structural work, a separate category for solar panels with structural work, and an electrical permit category for solar.

facts.text: The fee schedule lists a building-permit category for solar panels without structural work.
It separately lists structural-work building permits for solar panels.
It lists an electrical permit category for solar panels.
Electrical permit applications are filed online and require an appropriately signed electrical license.

qa.q: Does a solar installation need an electrical permit in Newton?
qa.a: The fee schedule lists an electrical permit category for solar panels.

qa.q: Is a building permit needed if there's no structural work?
qa.a: The fee schedule lists a building permit category for solar panels without structural work.

qa.q: Do historic district rules apply to solar?
qa.a: Exterior changes in local historic districts require HDC review.
